advertising.partnerSubtitle: Request to sponsor or feature your own jobs / events. The public label is mandatory and cannot be removed.
advertising.disclosureNotice: Every approved placement shows a “Sponsored” or “Featured” label on the marketplace. This label is mandatory and cannot be turned off.
advertising.emptyBody: Create a request to sponsor or feature one of your jobs or events.
advertising.emptyFilterBody: There are no placements in this status. Try another filter.
advertising.permissionBody: You do not have permission to manage advertising for this organization.
advertising.cancelNote: The request will move to cancelled and cannot continue.
advertising.cancelActiveNote: An active placement stops immediately and the sponsored/featured label is removed from the target (unless another placement still covers it).
advertising.deleteNote: Only draft or rejected requests can be deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.limitBody: You have reached the maximum of 3 active placements. Wait for one to end before submitting a new request.
errors.existsBody: This job / event already has an active advertising request.
errors.conflictBody: This request was updated elsewhere. The list has been reloaded.
errors.targetGoneBody: The selected job / event is no longer available or does not belong to your organization.

form.subtitle: Pick a target, a package and a start date. The end date is derived from the package duration.
form.targetLabel: Target (one of your jobs or events)
form.targetHint: Only jobs and events owned by your organization are shown.
form.targetLockedHint: The target cannot be changed after the request is created.
form.noTargets: You have no jobs or events to advertise yet.
form.startHint: The placement runs once approved, paid and the start date arrives.
form.disclosureLabel: I understand this placement will be labelled as sponsored and the label cannot be removed.
form.disclosureHelp: The “Sponsored” / “Featured” label is mandatory and shown publicly for the whole run window.
form.disclosureRequired: You must confirm the public label before submitting.

advertising.insightPendingApproval: Placements awaiting university approval — expect 1-2 business days for review
advertising.insightActiveCampaigns: Your sponsored placements are live and visible to VinUni students on the marketplace
advertising.insightDraftsPending: You have draft requests — submit them to start reaching students
advertising.insightGetStarted: Sponsor a job or event to boost its visibility to verified VinUni students
advertising.noDeliveryHint: Delivery is counted from real ad events only. A campaign that hasn't started shows no delivery.
advertising.deliveryUnavailable: Delivery metrics aren't available right now.

sheet.title: Campaign
sheet.noDeliveryBody: This campaign hasn't served any impressions yet. Delivery appears once it starts running.

campaign.title: Ad campaigns
campaign.subtitle: Create and manage sponsored campaigns that compete for the limited paid slots across the VinUni marketplace.
campaign.disclosureNotice: Every approved campaign shows a “Sponsored” label on every placement. This label is required by advertising policy and cannot be turned off or removed.

empty.allBody: Create your first campaign to sponsor a job, event, or brand message to VinUni students.
empty.filterBody: There are no campaigns in this status. Try another filter.

campaign.permissionBody: You don't have permission to manage advertising for this organization. Ask a partner admin to grant the “advertising” capability.

errors.conflictBody: This campaign was updated elsewhere. The list has been reloaded.
errors.disclosureRequired: You must confirm the public label before submitting.
errors.targetingForbidden: That targeting dimension isn't allowed. Only coarse signals like city, major, career interest, and work mode are permitted.
errors.limitBody: Your organization has reached the maximum number of in-flight campaigns. End one before submitting another.

detail.noPerformanceBody: Metrics appear once the campaign starts delivering.
detail.noCreative: No creative yet. Add a headline or image before this campaign can serve.

action.none: No actions available for this status.

confirm.endBody: End “{name}”? It will stop serving and cannot be resumed.
confirm.deleteBody: Delete the draft “{name}”? This cannot be undone.

reach.broad: Broad reach — shown to every eligible viewer.

form.subtitle: Set a budget, objective, schedule, and coarse audience. VinUni reviews it before it can serve.
form.surfaceHint: The campaign competes for the limited sponsored slots on this surface.
form.budgetHint: Your maximum budget. VinUni sets the delivery rate; the budget caps total spend.
form.scheduleRequired: Choose a start and end date.
form.scheduleOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
form.targetingHint: Coarse signals only. Never exact/GPS location or sensitive categories. Leave empty for broad reach.
form.creativeHint: This is what students see. Add at least a headline or an image so the campaign can serve.
form.imageHint: Paste an approved banner image URL. Leave empty for a text-only card.
form.disclosureLabel: I understand this campaign will show a non-removable “Sponsored” label once approved.
form.disclosureHelp: The sponsored label is required by advertising policy and shows publicly for the whole run.
form.disclosureRequired: You must confirm the public label before submitting.
